name: zcode-community-market
description: Community plugin marketplace for ZCode: explore, install, update and manage community plugins from a side panel; includes a shared settings hub other plugins can call, and an optional settings-page entry injected into ZCode's Settings.

description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 社区插件市场：在侧栏面板里探索、安装、更新与管理社区插件；内置可供其他插件调用的共享设置中心，可选注入 ZCode 设置页入口。
